title: Matthew Brown's WMD corruption whistleblowing

tellings.quote: There's a lot of things corruption things to do with um WMDs that was his specialty that that he also whistle blew on

plain: A State Department official named Matthew Brown is said to have also blown the whistle on corruption involving WMDs, weapons of mass destruction, his area of expertise, in the 2020s. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell says so, passing on what he knows of Brown. It is told to show Brown has spoken out on serious matters beyond UFOs.
